text:
maria: Quick checklist—prelaunch SEO for April webinar + launch blog. Need keywords, event JSON-LD, internal anchors, and redirect table for legacy posts.
aj: dates? link?
maria: Landing live 2026-04-01, webinar 2026-04-15 10am PT. Link: https://redwood.inference/webinar/april-2026
sam: I'll own keyword families and internal linking. Deliver CSV with columns: slug, primary_kw, related_kws, target_page, anchor_text by Fri 3/29.
maria: Primary themes: "low latency LLM inference", "dedicated GPU inference", "inference cost optimization". Map to resource vs product pages.
olivia: I'll build Event schema and FAQ schema. Reminder: include server-side rendered JSON-LD. Draft snippet:
```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference launch webinar","startDate":"2026-04-15T10:00:00-07:00","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.inference/webinar/april-2026"}}
```
seo-bot: Found legacy slugs to redirect: /blog/latency-tuning -> /resources/latency (301), /blog/dedicated-nodes -> /products/dedicated (301), /old/embedding-cost -> /guides/embeddings-costs (301).
sam: I'll create redirect CSV with columns: source, target, redirect_type, owner, test_plan. Will include UTM preservation test steps.
aj: Who implements redirects? eng-platform can do global routing; eng-frontend must expose canonical meta.
devex-bot: Reminder: server-side meta tags + OpenGraph for social. Use canonical pointing to landing for syndicated copies.
maria: Deliverables: sam keyword CSV + redirect CSV by 2026-03-29, olivia schema + meta snippets by 2026-03-27, aj confirm infra rollout window by 2026-03-30. Tag me on blockers. :rocket:
